decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - Reason for Approval: The building complies with the specific U.D.P. policy for Duke's Meadows (ENV-N.1.8) as it is ancillary to an open space recreational use and does not exceed 4.0m high; it is not readily visible from public parts of Duke's Meadows or residential accommodation and would not significantly increase the activity of the sports club, as the area beneath the proposed pergola is already used for seating. The scheme therefore complies with policy ENV 1.1 and the other U.D.P. policies concerning metropolitan open land.
description: Erection of timber pergola with retractable cover to existing sports club
